messages.subject: Using highlight.js
parts:
I'm attempting to use <a href='https://highlightjs.org/'>highlight.js</a> with shiny. I have downloaded version 8.7 of the script and I have put all files in the www folder of my shiny app. Following the directions in <a href='https://highlightjs.org/usage/'>usage</a> I have included in my ui.R file the following:
<bre />
<pre>
shinyUI(fluidPage(
tags$head(
tags$link(rel = "stylesheet", href = "default.css"),
tags$script(src = "highlight.pack.js"),
tags$script('hljs.initHighlightingOnLoad();')
),
...
)
</pre>

However, highlight does not appear to working. Any hints will be appreciated!

DR
